description:
Cast Revenge by paying its mana cost, doubling your life total.
If Sorin is on the battlefield as Sorin of House Markov, move to your postcombat main phase. Sorin of House Markov's second ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Sorin, Ravenous Neonate.
Activate Sorin, Ravenous Neonate's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, dealing damage to target opponent equal to the life you gained this turn.

uses.name: Sorin of House Markov // Sorin, Ravenous Neonate
